en: I'm halfway through my degree at Cambridge.
zh: 我在剑桥的学位已经读到一半了。

en: In my second year of computer science.
zh: 现在是我计算机科学专业的第二年。

en: I've got to balance my exam prep with finding a job for the summer,
zh: 我得一边准备考试，一边找暑假的工作，

en: all whilst enjoying the dwindling time I have left in the city.
zh: 同时还要好好享受我在这座城市所剩不多的时光。

en: And it doesn't help that this year.
zh: 更麻烦的是，今年，

en: I'm getting kicked out of college accommodation.
zh: 我还要被赶出学院宿舍了。

en: Let me back. But you know what that means New roommates.
zh: 让我回去吧。不过你知道这意味着什么：新室友。

en: I sort of know them, but I'll be honest, I'm a bit nervous to live with them.
zh: 我算是认识他们，但说实话，想到要和他们一起住，我有点紧张。

en: I've heard of them breaking into people's rooms and putting laundry detergent into people's milk.
zh: 我听说他们会闯进别人房间，还会把洗衣液倒进别人的牛奶里。

en: So at the start of the year, I'm genuinely a bit cautious already.
zh: 所以这一年刚开始，我其实就已经有点警惕了。

en: Obviously, I know it'll probably be fine.
zh: 当然，我知道大概率不会有什么事。

en: Right? I don't know what I'm in for, do I?
zh: 对吧？我也不知道接下来等着我的是什么。

en: Yo! No! Though my housing situation differs from last year.
zh: 哟！不是吧！虽然今年我的住宿情况和去年不一样。

en: one constant that remains is the glorious computer lab.
zh: 但有一个不变的地方，就是辉煌的计算机实验室。

en: Because this year, every lecture we have happens here.
zh: 因为今年我们所有的课都在这里上。

en: A 10-minute cycle from college.
zh: 从学院骑车过来要10分钟。

en: In Cambridge terms, intercontinental.
zh: 按剑桥的标准，这都算跨洲旅行了。

en: This place stresses me out.
zh: 这个地方让我压力很大。

en: Every other guy you see has an internship lined up for the summer.
zh: 你看到的几乎每个男生，暑假都已经安排好了实习。

en: Many for six-figure jobs.
zh: 很多都是年薪六位数的工作。

en: I'm convinced the business school is a less lucrative place.
zh: 我都觉得商学院可能都没这里赚钱。

en: People talk about startups, big tech and trading firms almost every day.
zh: 大家几乎每天都在聊创业、大厂和交易公司。

en: And there I am, barely holding on during graphics lectures.
zh: 而我呢，图形学课都快撑不住了。

en: So I hopped on the recruiting trend.
zh: 所以我也跟上了找工作的潮流。

en: I want a job too.
zh: 我也想要一份工作。

en: If my friends could secure themselves great internships, so could I.
zh: 如果我的朋友们都能拿到很棒的实习，那我也可以。

en: I begin scouring job boards for anything tech-related just to get my foot in the door.
zh: 我开始疯狂刷招聘网站，找任何和科技相关的岗位，只想先挤进去。

en: One of these companies is surely going to want a piece of my highly technical skillset.
zh: 这些公司里总有一家会看中我这套高度技术化的技能吧。

en: I wasn't going to let them tell me otherwise.
zh: 我才不会让他们告诉我不是这样。

en: Oh my god. It's a bloodbath.
zh: 我的天，简直是腥风血雨。

en: So I guess it's going to be a bit more challenging than I had imagined.
zh: 所以看来这事会比我想象中更有挑战一点。

en: Rejection's a funny thing.
zh: 被拒绝这件事挺有意思的。

en: Most people at Cambridge haven't experienced enough of it.
zh: 剑桥的大多数人都没怎么经历过被拒。

en: And neither had I.
zh: 我也一样。

en: Just seeing the extent to which all these great companies seem to agree over my lack of value had me really questioning my abilities.
zh: 看到这么多优秀公司似乎都一致认定我没什么价值，真的让我开始怀疑自己的能力。

en: With a new focus on recruiting for the summer.
zh: 因为现在把重点转向了暑期招聘，

en: I've had to make drastic changes to the social schedule of this year.
zh: 我不得不对今年的社交安排做出重大调整。

en: Practically every week in my first year, you'd find me out at a club
zh: 第一年的时候，几乎每周你都能在夜店里找到我，

en: or some event. But this is simply not a sustainable lifestyle for someone as serious
zh: 或者在某个活动上。但这种生活方式，对我这样认真

en: and employable as myself.
zh: 且具备就业竞争力的人来说，显然是不可持续的。

en: Instead, I'm trying my hand at the College Formal Challenge.
zh: 所以我改为尝试学院正式晚宴挑战。

en: Everyone knows by the time you finish a degree at Cambridge, you've got to have visited every college for a formal.
zh: 大家都知道，在剑桥读完一个学位之前，你必须去每个学院参加一次正式晚宴。

en: With 31 different colleges to visit and only 6 checked off from my first year,
zh: 一共有31个学院要去，而我第一年只打卡了6个，

en: I've not been doing great.
zh: 进度实在不太理想。

en: I've got to pick up the pace.
zh: 我得加快节奏了。

en: Starting with Tit Hall, Churchill and Girton.
zh: 先从Tit Hall、Churchill和Girton开始。

en: and Pembroke, Sydney and Lucy also get checked off.
zh: Pembroke、Sidney和Lucy也顺利打卡。

en: Second year also brings along with it another substitute to going out,
zh: 大二还带来了另一个替代外出玩乐的选择，

en: owing to the fact that many people move out of internal college accommodation into external college housing.
zh: 因为很多人会从学院内部宿舍搬到学院外部住房。

en: So you get to visit a lot of houses.
zh: 所以你就能去参观很多房子。

en: Hayden Young, he is the GOAT.
zh: Hayden，他是永远的神。

en: I don't like him.
zh: 我不喜欢他。

en: I love Hayden. I love men, I love women and I love people.
zh: 我爱Hayden。我爱男人，我爱女人，我爱所有人。

en: I love men too.
zh: 我也爱男人。

en: But honestly, what I really need this year is less social time
zh: 但说真的，今年我真正需要的是少一点社交时间，

en: and more desk time.
zh: 多一点坐在书桌前的时间。

en: Because the first term of a second year Cambridge Computer Science degree.
zh: 因为剑桥计算机科学大二第一学期，

en: is probably one of the densest academic experiences you could give to someone.
zh: 大概是一个人能经历到的最密集的学术体验之一。

en: Something like 2,500 slides of lecture content is delivered in the span of 8 weeks.
zh: 大概有2500页课件内容，要在8周内讲完。

en: It can easily become a 70-hour work week where you still manage to fall behind.
zh: 它很容易变成每周工作70个小时，但你还是会落后。

en: So I really needed to lock in.
zh: 所以我真的得认真起来了。

en: My god, one of my internship applications.
zh: 我的天，我的一个实习申请，

en: They got back to me.
zh: 他们回复我了。

en: It was great getting the chance to meet you in our online interviews.
zh: 很高兴能在我们的线上面试中见到你。

en: We'd love to have you come to the London office for a final round.
zh: 我们希望邀请你来伦敦办公室参加最终轮面试。

en: I knew the final in-person interview was supposed to be really tough.
zh: 我知道最后这轮线下面试应该会非常难。

en: It's had a great company with an amazing internship program.
zh: 这是一家很棒的公司，也有非常优秀的实习项目。

en: So I just knew I had to make the bar.
zh: 所以我知道自己必须达到他们的标准。

en: With this in mind, I decided to play the strategic degree gambit
zh: 带着这个想法，我决定采取战略性学位弃子策略，

en: where I give up staying on top of my academic courses to prepare as hard as I can on interview preparation.
zh: 也就是放弃跟上课程进度，把全部精力都投入到面试准备上。

en: I just can't imagine this ending poorly.
zh: 我完全想象不到这会有什么糟糕的结局。

en: So after two weeks of absolute cramming.
zh: 于是，在整整两周疯狂突击之后，

en: fueled with meal deals and determination, I made my way to Cambridge Station.
zh: 靠着超市套餐和意志力支撑，我出发去了剑桥火车站。

en: It's actually really nice.
zh: 其实还挺不错的。

en: They've paid for the transport, a hotel for the night and for any meals
zh: 他们报销了交通费、一晚酒店，还有我在伦敦期间的所有餐费。

en: whilst I'm in London.
zh: 只要我人在伦敦。

en: It almost feels like I'm being pranked because the hotel is so nice.
zh: 这感觉简直像有人在整我，因为酒店太好了。

en: Hiya, I've got my room booked for Hayden Young.
zh: 你好，我订了Hayden 名下的房间。

en: I mean, all I did was get on a couple of interview calls,
zh: 我的意思是，我只是参加了几轮线上面试，

en: my basement room and now I'm really physically showing up to their office.
zh: 从我的地下室房间出发，现在居然真的亲自来到他们办公室了。

en: What a world we live in.
zh: 我们生活的这个世界真神奇。

en: I pick up some free dinner in central London and head back to the hotel.
zh: 我在伦敦市中心拿了一顿免费晚餐，然后回到酒店。

en: My interview's in the morning so I've got some time to relax
zh: 我的面试在第二天早上，所以我还有点时间放松一下，

en: and enjoy the luxury water here.
zh: 顺便享受一下这里奢华的矿泉水。

en: But before I head to bed, I start getting a bit nervous.
zh: 但在睡觉前，我开始有点紧张了。

en: I just have some typical doubts about my preparedness.
zh: 我只是产生了一些很典型的怀疑，担心自己准备得不够。

en: but I try not to let it stress me out.
zh: 但我尽量不让它给我太大压力。

en: I prepared a bunch for this interview.
zh: 我已经为这次面试准备了很多。

en: I'm going to try for nine hours of sleep so I'm as alert as possible tomorrow.
zh: 我打算睡足九个小时，这样明天能尽可能保持清醒。

en: I woke up at midnight and I just couldn't get back to sleep.
zh: 我半夜醒了，然后就再也睡不着了。

en: It's 5am now and I'm so hungry.
zh: 现在是早上5点，我饿得不行。

en: I've just started walking around.
zh: 我刚开始在外面到处走。

en: I don't really know what else to do.
zh: 我也不知道还能干什么。

en: I didn't do great in the interview.
zh: 那场面试我表现得不太好。

en: It was more than just sleep deprivation.
zh: 不只是因为睡眠不足。

en: I had let myself down.
zh: 是我让自己失望了。

en: I went home for the winter.
zh: 冬天的时候我回家了。

en: I spent time with friends.
zh: 我和朋友们待在一起。

en: It was nice. They said, Hayden, you know what will cheer you up?
zh: 感觉挺好的。他们说，Hayden，你知道什么能让你开心起来吗？

en: Put £5 on the table.
zh: 把5英镑放到桌上。

en: Play a hand of poker.
zh: 打一手扑克。

en: I had never played poker before.
zh: 我之前从来没玩过扑克。

en: and I hated the idea of gambling.
zh: 而且我讨厌赌博这个想法。

en: It just seems stupid.
zh: 它看起来就是很蠢。

en: Betting money when you've got no guarantee to win.
zh: 在完全不能保证会赢的情况下拿钱去赌。

en: But I was weak.
zh: 但那时的我很脆弱。

en: I was broken. Why not learn to just play a few hands of this game?
zh: 我崩了。那为什么不学着玩几手这个游戏呢？

en: I win. Wait. This game is awesome.
zh: 我赢了。等等，这游戏也太爽了。

en: I start next term bringing friends to the basement to play games on the weekend.
zh: 下个学期一开始，我就开始周末把朋友们带到地下室玩游戏。

en: I'm not addicted but damn it's fun.
zh: 我没有上瘾，但该死，这真的很好玩。

en: And what's better? The house always wins.
zh: 更妙的是什么？庄家总是赢。

en: I was pretty good at keeping profitable.
zh: 我很擅长保持盈利。

en: Soon word spreads of the underground gambling thing and our numbers grow.
zh: 很快，地下赌博局的消息传开了，来的人也越来越多。

en: Every week I set up a game and squeeze 20 people into my kitchen.
zh: 每周我都会组一局，把20个人塞进我的厨房。

en: Honestly, it's not just about the poker.
zh: 说实话，这不只是扑克。

en: Running these games brings my friends from all over the university together.
zh: 组织这些牌局，把我来自全校各处的朋友们聚到了一起。

en: I know this is something I'll miss when I'm gone.
zh: 我知道，等我离开之后，我会怀念这件事。

en: I really look forward to every Saturday where I bring another few new friends to join.
zh: 我真的很期待每个周六，因为我又会带几个新朋友来加入。

en: And I use the game to branch out a bit, playing in the pub against the Cambridge locals
zh: 我也借着这个游戏拓展了一点社交圈，在酒吧里和剑桥本地人打牌，

en: and playing at the university society.
zh: 也去大学社团里打牌。

en: I really like the game.
zh: 我真的很喜欢这个游戏。

en: but I don't want to encourage degenerate gambling unless you're really good at it.
zh: 但我不想鼓励堕落式赌博，除非你真的很擅长。
